about: The RabbitOS / rabbitsoftware.io platform: what exists, how it connects, and what comes next. One file, used for the map, the roadmap, the Supabase tables and the weekly audit.

nodes.label: Visitors
nodes.about: Anyone with a browser.

nodes.label: AI assistants
nodes.about: Claude, Gemini and Copilot, in the guest shell or on a computer.

nodes.label: Owner
nodes.about: Signs in to the owner consoles and runs the scripts.

nodes.label: rabbitsoftware.io
nodes.about: The public website on Cloudflare Pages.

nodes.label: Status page
nodes.about: rabbitsoftware.io/status.html: live status, map and public data tree.

nodes.label: RabbitOS app
nodes.about: app.rabbitsoftware.io on Cloudflare Workers: the console and the public data and chain APIs.

nodes.label: Guest shell gate
nodes.about: Worker that checks the human check and the limits, then opens a terminal.

nodes.label: Owner consoles
nodes.about: Sign-in consoles for the owner (Cloudflare Access and Supabase sign-in).

nodes.label: Hub MCP
nodes.about: Read-only tool server for AI assistants: links, status, public chain and data, commands.

nodes.label: Standby website
nodes.about: A copy of rabbitsoftware.io on Cloud Run, ready if Pages is down.

nodes.label: Failover Worker
nodes.about: Written and tested; not on the live route yet.

nodes.label: Cloudflare sandbox
nodes.about: The original guest terminal, kept as the fallback.

nodes.label: Owner shell broker
nodes.about: Runs commands for the signed-in owner only.

nodes.label: Visitor shell
nodes.about: Cloud Run: one throwaway terminal per guest, with claude, gemini, copilot and common languages.

nodes.label: Allowlist proxy
nodes.about: The only way out of the visitor shell: 13 named hosts, nothing else.

nodes.label: App mirror
nodes.about: A read copy of the console on Cloud Run (run.rabbitsoftware.io).

nodes.label: Status recorder
nodes.about: Cloud Run job, every 5 minutes: checks the public services and writes the feed.

nodes.label: Weekly audit
nodes.about: Scheduler, Workflow and Cloud Run job: crawls both sites and writes a report with maps.

nodes.label: Vertex AI (Gemini)
nodes.about: The Gemini model that assistants on the owner's computer use.

nodes.label: Kubernetes cluster
nodes.about: Not created. A script is ready if it is ever wanted.

nodes.label: Research agents
nodes.about: Python agents that find public research and sync it through a signed ingest.

nodes.label: Daily backup job
nodes.about: Windows scheduled task at 3:00 AM: miner, chain mirror, backups.

nodes.label: Vault agent
nodes.about: Runs approved jobs on the owner's vault. Owner only.

nodes.label: Allowed internet
nodes.about: Package registries, GitHub, the model APIs and the public RabbitOS app.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.about: Supabase Postgres: 29 tables, row-level security on every table; the system of record.

nodes.label: Packages bucket
nodes.about: Public downloads.

nodes.label: R2 buckets (6)
nodes.about: Chain mirror, sync and vault storage.

nodes.label: Public ledger
nodes.about: World-readable copy of the public chain.

nodes.label: Status feed
nodes.about: World-readable status files for the status page.

nodes.label: Private backups
nodes.about: Versioned private backups. Never reachable from the guest shell.

nodes.label: Audit reports
nodes.about: Private: the weekly audit reports.

nodes.label: BigQuery analytics
nodes.about: Service events, refused requests and status checks, kept 90 days.

nodes.label: Maxwell chain
nodes.about: The local chain file and the rabbit web data miner that anchors snapshots on it.

nodes.label: Personal data
nodes.about: EEG, wearables and labs. Stays on the computer; never sent to a cloud.

nodes.label: Logs, metrics, alerts
nodes.about: Cloud Logging, log-based metrics, five alert policies and a dashboard.

edges.label: runs the miner and the anchor

roadmap.title: Guest shell runs on Google Cloud
roadmap.note: Throwaway terminal per visitor behind an allowlist proxy; tested end to end.

roadmap.title: Hub MCP with guest and owner commands
roadmap.note: Read-only tools, safe command drafting, agents and languages listed honestly.

roadmap.title: claude, gemini and copilot verified in both shell images
roadmap.note: The build now fails if any of the three cannot run.

roadmap.title: Standby website on Cloud Run
roadmap.note: Refreshed by re-running Setup-GcpStandby.ps1.

roadmap.title: Logging, metrics, alerts, dashboard and BigQuery analytics
roadmap.note: Five alert policies; no visitor IP addresses are stored.

roadmap.title: Proxy VM on a least-privilege account
roadmap.note: It can only write logs and metrics.

roadmap.title: Live status feed and status page
roadmap.note: Updates every 5 minutes; goes stale visibly; alert if the recorder stops.

roadmap.title: Weekly audit with score, fixes and maps
roadmap.note: Mondays 09:00 Los Angeles time; reports kept 180 days.

roadmap.title: Rabbit web data miner on the Maxwell chain
roadmap.note: Block 2 mined; the daily job runs it from the next 3:00 AM run.

roadmap.title: Supabase tree, checked against the live database
roadmap.note: 29 tables; the 8 closed ones refuse an anonymous reader.

roadmap.title: Try the guest shell in a browser
roadmap.note: Needs the human check, which only a person can pass.

roadmap.title: Apply the platform-graph SQL in the Supabase SQL editor
roadmap.note: Two files: the tables, then the data. Nothing is written until you run them.

roadmap.title: Push the local commits to GitHub
roadmap.note: All three repositories have commits that exist only on this computer.

roadmap.title: Deploy the RabbitOS app
roadmap.note: Adds the prompt box, key toggle and save/restore buttons to the guest shell page.

roadmap.title: Create a hub key and test the owner role
roadmap.note: Run New-HubKey.ps1; the key goes to the clipboard and is never printed.

roadmap.title: Check the Google Cloud credit balance and its terms
roadmap.note: It cannot be read from here.

roadmap.title: Relink the local audit chain
roadmap.note: From the 2026-10-09 notes: python .\relink_audit_once.py, then python .\rabbit_sync.py. May already be done.

roadmap.title: Back up the contact-records private key offline, in two places
roadmap.note: From the 2026-10-09 notes; before opening sign-ups.

roadmap.title: Update privacy.html
roadmap.note: Draft in docs/privacy-page-change.md; has decisions only you can make.

roadmap.title: Give every RabbitOS page its own title
roadmap.note: 38 pages share a title; the app's pages are all just 'RabbitOS'.

roadmap.title: Add meta descriptions to 5 website pages
roadmap.note: local, agent, license, recovery, dna-code.

roadmap.title: Add a main heading to /downloads in the app
Enforce the app's Content Security Policy
roadmap.note: It is report-only today; the csp-enforce-public branch exists.

roadmap.title: Publish a sitemap for the app
Add canonical addresses and link previews
roadmap.note: Low priority; every page lacks them.

roadmap.title: Review refused egress requests each month
roadmap.note: A BigQuery query in docs/gcp-observability.md shows which hosts visitors ask for.

roadmap.title: Put the failover Worker on the live route
roadmap.note: Written and tested. Use fail-open routing; test on a separate address first.

roadmap.title: Anchor Merkle roots on the XRPL
roadmap.note: Needs a wallet secret stored as a Cloudflare secret, never pasted in chat.

roadmap.title: Personal-data vault with grants
roadmap.note: Not started. Personal data stays on the owner's computer until then.

roadmap.title: Open sign-ups
roadmap.note: Stays off in Supabase until the live checks pass.

roadmap.title: Kubernetes cluster
roadmap.note: Optional. Cloud Run covers the needs today; Setup-GcpGke.ps1 is ready.
